title: AT-99 Scorpion gunship (Avatar)

sources.title: AT-99 Scorpion Gunship from Avatar (Fantastic Plastic)

intro: The AT-99 Scorpion is a fictional gunship of the RDA company in James Cameron's film Avatar (2009). It flies with two rotors in round ducts and can hover like a helicopter. One pilot sits in a sealed, pressurised cockpit at the front and flies with a cyclic and a collective, the two controls of a helicopter; it carries missiles and two forward machine guns.

panels.name: Sealed canopy
panels.text: The closed, pressurised canopy of the gunship.
panels.context: Pandora's air is not safe to breathe for humans, so the cockpit is sealed.

controls.name: Sealed canopy
controls.text: The cockpit is sealed and pressurised, so the pilot needs no breathing mask in Pandora's air.
controls.context: Outside the cockpit humans need masks on Pandora.

areas.name: Instrument panel
areas.text: Transparent and flat displays in front of the pilot.

panels.name: Instrument panel
panels.text: See-through and flat screens with flight data, targeting and the weapons.
panels.context: The film shows the screens as clear glass panels in front of the pilot.

controls.name: Transparent displays
controls.text: See-through screens show the flight data and the targeting picture.
controls.context: The pilot can look through them and still see outside.

controls.name: Weapon status
controls.text: A screen shows the state of the guns and missiles.
controls.context: It tells the pilot what is armed and how much is left.

panels.name: Side consoles
panels.text: Controls beside the Scorpion pilot's seat for the systems.
panels.context: The film does not show what each control does.

controls.name: Side controls
controls.text: Switches for the gunship's systems on the consoles beside the seat.
controls.context: They are part of the cockpit as seen in the film; each one is not named.

areas.name: Cyclic and collective
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Cyclic
panels.text: The cyclic stick in front of the pilot, in the right hand.
panels.context: It tilts the gunship to fly forward, back and sideways and holds the weapon buttons.

controls.name: Cyclic
controls.text: Pushing the cyclic forward tips the gunship forward so it flies forward; moving it sideways makes it fly sideways.
controls.context: Like a helicopter's cyclic, it tilts the lift of the rotors in the direction the pilot wants to go.

controls.name: Gun trigger
controls.text: A trigger on the cyclic grip fires the two forward machine guns.
controls.context: The pilot aims them by pointing the gunship's nose.

controls.name: Missile release
controls.text: A thumb button on the cyclic grip launches the missiles.
controls.context: Missiles are the gunship's strongest weapons, for bigger targets.

panels.name: Collective
panels.text: The collective lever at the pilot's left hand.
panels.context: It makes the gunship climb or sink.

controls.name: Collective
controls.text: Pulling the collective up gives the rotors more lift so the gunship climbs; pushing it down makes it sink.
controls.context: Together with the cyclic it is how every helicopter-like craft is flown.
